System

Dedicated-server bootstrap, possession and replication

Start a headless authority process and two independent clients early. GameMode controls admission/spawning in its one server world; PlayerState is an in-zone replicated actor, not a database or a cross-process singleton.

Scope and player interaction

Start a headless authority process and two independent clients early. GameMode controls admission/spawning in its one server world; PlayerState is an in-zone replicated actor, not a database or a cross-process singleton.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase03committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Disconnected → Connecting → Admitted → Hydrating → Possessed → Ready → Reconnecting → Rejected

WBP_Diagnostics observes results from ARPGZoneGameMode. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Zone_NetworkLab. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
ZoneInstanceId: backend-allocated UUID; one live authority lease
CharacterSessionEpoch: monotonic fencing integer; backend verified
CharacterRevision: monotonic durable snapshot version
SpawnReady: server state after content and snapshot validation
PublicPlayerState: display name, class, level, safe appearance; no private bag contents
ReplicationBaseline: generic actor/property/RPC; explicit relevancy and ownership

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
ARPGZoneGameModeImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_DiagnosticsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
AdmitPlayer(AdmissionProof, BuildVersion) -> Pending|Unauthorized|VersionMismatch; server admission contract
HydratePlayer(CharacterSnapshot, SessionEpoch) -> Ready|InvalidRecord; server-only
SpawnAndPossessReadyCharacter(PlayerController) -> Pawn|SpawnBlocked; server-only
PublishOwnerSnapshot(Revision) -> OwnerOnlyUpdate; server custom notification

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Start Server_A without a local player. It registers zone instance/content version and obtains its backend lease before accepting durable actions.
  2. Client_A and Client_B authenticate and connect using separate controllers/identities; admission validates tickets before a gameplay body is enabled.
  3. GameMode creates or uses the intended PlayerState, hydrates authorized durable data through the server adapter, and spawns exactly one body at a valid PlayerStart.
  4. Server possession initializes character components explicitly. Client OnRep/readiness observers may arrive in another order; a guarded readiness function binds UI/ASC only when all prerequisites exist.
  5. Replicate movement and compact public presentation to relevant clients; replicate inventory/private quest details to the owner only.
  6. On disconnect, cancel input-driven actions, apply the combat-logout policy, checkpoint accepted state, then release/revoke the lease through the backend. Reconnect always revalidates identity and epoch.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Use the official dedicated-server source-build route. Create native GameMode, GameState, PlayerController, PlayerState and Character bases in the developer's C++ project, compile, then create their BP children.
  2. BP_ZoneGameMode Class Defaults: PlayerControllerClass=BP_RPGPlayerController, PlayerStateClass=BP_RPGPlayerState, GameStateClass=BP_ZoneGameState; gate DefaultPawn spawn until hydration. A project custom restart/spawn route must not duplicate automatic spawning.
  3. Project Settings > Maps & Modes: set BP_RPGGameInstance and menu/gameplay defaults; L_NetworkLab World Settings uses BP_ZoneGameMode.
  4. Enable replication on the native character/state actors and required components; assign ownership intentionally. Do not rely on Replicates to automatically replicate arbitrary variables or PaperZD graphs.
  5. Place two separated PlayerStarts in L_NetworkLab and remove manually placed auto-possessed pawns. Start one dedicated process and two separate clients; PIE is a preliminary diagnostic, not packaged proof.
  6. Reopen BP_RPGPlayerController to bind remote-safe diagnostics and local-only camera/input/UI. Server logs must identify distinct net connections and CharacterIds.

Reopen Phase03 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_NetworkLab / Server_A / Client_A / Client_B. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Same character joins twice -> AlreadyOnline or controlled reconnect takeover with a new epoch, never two economic writers.
Client attempts to write wallet/XP property locally -> server state unchanged; owner snapshot corrects display.
Wrong content/build version -> VersionMismatch before possession; no partial inventory hydration.
Backend unavailable during admission -> remain connecting/error, not an unauthenticated fallback pawn.
Remove presentation component -> authority movement/combat still operates in headless tests.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Initial planning target 2 clients, then 8 and 16 per zone under measured load. Proposed 30 Hz server simulation and explicit actor update frequencies require profiling; they are not benchmarks.

Separate connection ID, account pseudonymous audit ID, CharacterId, ZoneInstanceId and epoch. Record admission/hydration/spawn/ready transitions and owner-only data exposure checks.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
